title: Zoomable image viewer without zoom buttons

license.name: Apache-2.0
license.copyright: Não declarado no LICENSE (modelo Apache-2.0 sem titular)

component.description: A zoomable viewer that wraps its child in an InteractiveViewer and animates a 2x zoom on double tap.

violations.description: Zooming is only possible through pinch and double-tap gestures; InteractiveViewer pinch and onDoubleTap are not exposed as semantic actions, and no zoom buttons are provided.

mutations.description: Variant without the zoom in and zoom out buttons (and their _zoomBy helper), keeping only the pinch and double-tap gestures.

notes: Fonte acessível ausente no código real (ADR-R014): a variante violation é o SmoothInteractiveViewer original e a variante accessible foi construída pelos pesquisadores, adicionando botões de zoom com tooltip (_zoomBy e Positioned com dois IconButton.filledTonal). Adaptação do original (ADR-R011): SmoothAnimationsDuration.short foi substituído por Duration(milliseconds: 200) (duration_constants.dart). Os chamadores no app exibem PinchToZoomExplainer, confirmando a ausência de alternativa no original.
